## LiteScriptManager v0.1.5

This release fixes an "invalid handle" error that stopped files from opening. In a live app instance, the script page's **Edit** button, the run-log opener and the updater's release-page link could all fail with `os error 6` — not because the file or the program was wrong, but because a process-wide standard-handle slot held a dead handle that the helper was asked to inherit. Openers now spawn with explicit null standard streams on both platforms. The release workflow also publishes the bilingual notes from the repository, so the published release and the in-app update check show the real notes instead of GitHub's one-line changelog. No database change, and existing settings, schedules, triggers and history carry over.

## Fixes

### Opening a file could fail with "invalid handle"

On a running instance, the script page's **Edit** button reported an invalid-handle error (`ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE` / `os error 6`) even though Notepad and the script path were both fine.

- A graceful stop detaches the console through `FreeConsole` / `AttachConsole`, which rewrites the process-wide standard-handle slots, and the slots keep the stale values afterwards. Reading that process's PEB showed `StandardInput` holding a handle the process could no longer use.
- Rust's `Command::spawn` makes inherited standard handles inheritable, so a slot holding a dead handle fails at `CreateProcess` — before the child exists. The broken thing is the handle list, not the target file.
- `spawn_opener` was the only spawn path without explicit stdio: `run_capture` and the runner pass null or piped handles, and the installer goes through `ShellExecuteW`. That one path served three things — editing a script, opening a run's log, and opening the release page from the updater — so all three could fail together.
- Openers now spawn through `spawn_silent`, which passes null stdin, stdout and stderr on both Windows and Unix. An opener reads none of them, and the child no longer inherits the app's handles at all.

A Windows regression test installs a closed handle in the stdin slot inside a child copy of the test binary — the slots are per process, so corrupting the harness itself would break every other test that spawns with inherited stdio. The old call returned `ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE`; the new one starts the helper.

### The release notes actually reach the release

The v0.1.4 workflow used `generate_release_notes`, so the published release carried GitHub's auto-generated one-line changelog instead of `.github/release-notes/v0.1.4.md`. It now resolves `.github/release-notes/<tag>.md` for the tag and uses it as the release body, with the name `LiteScriptManager <tag>`; a tag without a file still publishes, with the tag name as its notes. The in-app updater displays the release body, so the bilingual notes are visible in **Settings → About & Updates** as well. The English half of the v0.1.4 notes was also corrected to stay in English.

## Upgrading

- `LiteScriptManager_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe` is the per-user NSIS installer; no administrator rights needed. Windows 10/11 (x64) with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
- The database schema is unchanged; settings, schedules, triggers and run history are carried over from v0.1.4.
- The release carries `LiteScriptManager_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe`, its `.sha256`, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. All three matter: the API path reads the first checksum, the fallback reads the manifest, and the updater still refuses to install without one.
- The v0.1.4 update check can find this release through its no-API fallback: `releases/latest` resolves to the tag and `SHA256SUMS.txt` supplies the installer name and digest, with no API quota spent.
- No new settings were added; there is nothing to reconfigure after upgrading.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Jaspersol/lite-script-manager/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.5

## 简体中文

## LiteScriptManager v0.1.5

这个版本修的是「打开文件时句柄无效」（`os error 6`）。在应用的运行实例上，脚本页的「编辑」、运行日志的打开入口，以及更新器里打开发布页的链接，都可能一起失效。问题不在文件或程序，而在于进程级的标准句柄槽位里留着一个已经失效的句柄，启动外部程序时却要求子进程继承它。现在所有「打开」入口都显式传入空的标准输入输出；发布工作流也会改用仓库里的中英双语发布说明，发布页和应用内更新检查不会再显示 GitHub 自动生成的一行变更记录。数据库结构没有变化，已有的设置、计划、触发器和历史记录都可直接沿用。

## 修复

### 打开文件报「句柄无效」

运行中的实例上，脚本页的「编辑」按钮会报 `打开文件失败: 句柄无效。 (os error 6)`，但记事本和脚本路径其实都没问题。

- 正常停止脚本时会通过 `FreeConsole` / `AttachConsole` 脱离控制台，这会重写进程级的标准句柄槽位，之后槽位里仍保留着旧值。读取该进程的 PEB 可以看到 `StandardInput` 指向一个进程已经无法使用的句柄。
- Rust 的 `Command::spawn` 会把继承的标准句柄设为可继承；槽位里若是一个失效句柄，`CreateProcess` 阶段就直接失败——子进程根本还没创建。错的是句柄列表，不是目标文件。
- `spawn_opener` 是唯一没有显式指定标准流的启动路径：`run_capture` 与 runner 传的是空句柄或管道，安装程序走 `ShellExecuteW`。而这唯一的一条路径同时服务于三件事：编辑脚本、打开运行日志、打开发布页链接，所以三个入口会一起失效。
- 现在「打开」入口统一走 `spawn_silent`，在 Windows 与 Unix 上都显式传入空的 stdin、stdout、stderr。打开程序本来就不读它们，子进程也不再继承应用的任何句柄。

新增的 Windows 回归测试会在测试二进制的子进程副本里，把一个已关闭的句柄装进 stdin 槽位——槽位是进程级的，直接在测试进程里破坏会影响其它所有使用继承标准流的测试。旧调用会返回 `ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE`，新调用可以正常启动外部程序。

### 发布说明终于出现在发布里

v0.1.4 的工作流里开着 `generate_release_notes: true`，于是发布页用的是 GitHub 自动生成的一行变更记录，而不是 `.github/release-notes/v0.1.4.md`。现在工作流会按 tag 查找 `.github/release-notes/<tag>.md` 并作为发布正文，标题设为 `LiteScriptManager <tag>`；没有对应文件的 tag 依然会发布，正文退化为 tag 名。应用内更新显示的就是发布正文，因此「设置 → 关于与更新」里也能看到完整的中英双语说明。v0.1.4 说明的英文部分也改回了纯英文。

## 升级

- `LiteScriptManager_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe` 是按用户安装的 NSIS 安装包，无需管理员权限。要求 Windows 10/11（x64）以及 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。
- 数据库结构没有变化，设置、计划、触发器与历史记录都可从 v0.1.4 直接沿用。
- 本次发布包含 `LiteScriptManager_0.1.5_x64-setup.exe`、它的 `.sha256`，以及 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。三个都重要：API 路径读第一个校验文件，兜底读清单，而没有校验值的包更新器依然拒绝安装。
- v0.1.4 的更新检查可以走不消耗 API 配额的兜底路径找到本版：`releases/latest` 重定向给出 tag，`SHA256SUMS.txt` 给出安装包名与摘要，全程不调用 API。
- 没有新增设置项，升级后无需重新配置。

**完整变更：** https://github.com/Jaspersol/lite-script-manager/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.5
